How to play

←→ / ADRun left and right Space / ↑ / WJump — hold for higher, tap for a hop P / EscPause & resume RRestart the current level MMute / unmute sound EnterConfirm on menus

Land on beetles to stomp them. Avoid spikes and pits. Collect lumens, find the gem, touch a checkpoint lantern to save your spot, and reach the big lantern to finish.

Tip: click the stage once to give it focus, then use the keyboard. On touch devices, use the on-screen buttons. Stuck? Open Story & Help.
